transcript.text: Thank you all for joining. I've called this meeting because the internal review has identified payments involving a foreign reseller that triggered sanctions-screening alerts, and we need to move forward carefully. As you know, no communication has been sent to OFAC yet, the reseller relationship is still active, and we're still holding funds connected with those reviewed payments. Before we can make any regulator submission or take any action on the reseller, company policy requires me to conduct a final review with sanctions, trade compliance, treasury, and commercial operations. And critically, before I sign off, each functional lead must formally disclose any material finding on the record -- not just discuss it verbally -- so it can be cited in the final package. So I'd like to go around the table: please share any material findings from your area, and we'll make sure everything is properly documented.
